record.bible_text: And Israel<WH03478> took his journey<WH05265><WTH8799> with all that he had, and came<WH0935><WTH8799> to Beersheba<WH0884>, and offered<WH02076><WTH8799> sacrifices<WH02077> unto the God<WH0430> of his father<WH01> Isaac<WH03327>.
